Marks as read a message the channel received from the contact. It works on Official WhatsApp channels and on WhatsApp Web channels, with WhatsApp Web enabled in the workspace. The body goes as JSON or as a form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`). The `messageId` is the one that came in the received message webhook; `phone` is required, but not used.

200.description: Message marked as read. A message sent by the channel itself also answers `200`, with no effect.

400.description: `phone` or `messageId` missing or empty, `messageId` equal to `.` or `..`, or a body that could not be read, such as malformed JSON. For a body that could not be read, the text describes the reading error. Nothing is marked.

value.error: messageId is required
messageId is invalid
invalid character 'n' looking for beginning of object key string

404.description: The message does not exist or belongs to another channel, with the channel connected. With the channel disconnected, the answer is `422` with `channel is disconnected`.

422.description: The message cannot be marked as read: it has no WhatsApp id, the channel is disconnected, the channel provider refused, or the channel subscription is not active. The connection is checked before the message: with the channel disconnected, any `messageId` gets `channel is disconnected`, even one that does not exist. On a WhatsApp Web channel, `422` also comes for a workspace without WhatsApp Web enabled, an instance not provisioned yet (checked before the message) and a message from a chat the route does not serve. A channel that is neither Official WhatsApp nor WhatsApp Web, such as Telegram, gets `422` with the channel type in the text. That text ends with `available only on Z-API (WhatsApp Web) instances`, the same ending of every refused route; this route also works on Official WhatsApp.

delete.description: Deletes, for everyone, a message sent by the channel or received from the contact. The parameters go in the query. The `messageId` is the message id in Omni Z-API, the same one that comes in the webhook. `phone` is required, as in Z-API, but it is not used; `owner` is accepted and is not used either. `deleteForMe=true` is not supported and gets `422`.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message `messageId`, as it came in the webhook. It is the message id in Omni Z-API, not the WhatsApp id

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Contact phone or group ID (country code + area code + number). Required, as in Z-API, but not used

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: `true` if the channel sent the message, `false` if it was received. Accepted for compatibility with Z-API, not used: the API already knows the chat and the direction of the message

parameters.name: deleteForMe
parameters.description: `true` to delete only for you ("delete for me"). It is not supported: the API answers `422`. Send `false` or leave the parameter out to delete for everyone

200.description: Request accepted. The deletion in WhatsApp happens right after.

400.description: Required field missing or empty, `messageId` equal to `.` or `..`, invalid value, or a body that could not be read, such as malformed JSON. Nothing is done.

value.error: messageId is required

404.description: The message does not exist or belongs to another channel.

422.description: The action could not be done. A channel that is not WhatsApp Web, including Official WhatsApp, gets `422` with the channel type in the text and what to use instead. Also getting `422`: channel subscription not active, channel disconnected, a message with no WhatsApp id or from a chat the route does not serve, a refusal by the channel provider, and a WhatsApp Web channel that does not have this action available yet (contact support). `deleteForMe=true` also gets `422`: a message can only be deleted for everyone.

value.error: deleting a message is not supported on META_WHATSAPP channels: the WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta) does not offer this action. This route works only on Z-API (WhatsApp Web) instances
deleting a message is not supported on BOT_TELEGRAM channels: this channel type does not offer this action. This route works only on Z-API (WhatsApp Web) instances
deleting a message only for this device (deleteForMe=true) is not supported: the Omni can only delete a message for everyone. To delete it for everyone, send deleteForMe=false or leave it out
